What degraded

  • The merge to main is held. CI is red on two checks only a maintainer can clear, so the email's images point at the run branch
  • tx-2026-0186 was not re-verified. www.faa.gov answered 403 to the project's reader and to WebFetch, and the safety classifier refused a browser agent read
  • The ask engine fix is written up as a proposal in the run record rather than committed, because scripts/site/ask_answers.py is maintainer owned
  • The deck ships at the round cap at 7.086, 0.914 under the 8.0 top rung, with five named defects left in place

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Cameras ride 50 brush trucks, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Cameras ride 50 Dallas brush trucks.

The trucks keep the routes they already run. The software is City Detect. It flags possible exterior property and right-of-way conditions along the way.

The city's October 19th briefing says an observation is not a confirmed Code violation. It says trained staff review every one before Code Compliance acts. In a prioritized inspection a Code Inspector goes on site to find out whether a violation exists.

The first letter a resident got used to be a formal notice of violation. The briefing says a first courtesy letter is now an educational reminder with no deadline.

The October 19th briefing publishes no accuracy figure. It lists calibrating detection accuracy and setting accuracy measures as next steps. How accurate was the camera across the 5,318 observations reviewed?

#Dallas #CityDetect #CodeCompliance

The machine changed itself

  • The weekly pass lifted no. 62's brush truck, camera pod, cut limb and limb rack into the kit at the judges' named fixes
    Primitive or missing models were named on 6 runs of 6 in the week, over 16 rounds
  • The kit monitor now publishes its exact display rectangle so a frame lays its screen on the glass
    No. 62's review queue screen first landed beside the bezel
  • The arsenal quotes the kit's own origin rule and marks for every model whether K.make moves its origin
    The centring moved a meaningful origin on 5 decks
  • layout_check now names the solid accent patch that would count and the closest frames, with the threshold unchanged
    Accent presence failures cost 4 decks repeated attempts
  • Four proposals wait on a maintainer in the upgrade backlog
    An origin anchor in the kit registry, a gate lessons entry, a detail floor check at the probe and audition, and the audition rebind rule each sit outside the upgrade lane

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

MERGE HELD. Two CI checks on pull request 450 are red and neither is this run's to clear. One action clears the first. A maintainer reads the FAA's Zipline review page for tx-2026-0186 and stamps it. One action clears the second. Apply the three line router patch in the run record to scripts/site/ask_answers.py. Then merge the pull request and the images below resolve on main. The record. Re-verify stamped 9 items confirmed and 53 dated unconfirmed lines. Two items were re-pointed to sources that read, tx-2026-0203 to the Taylor project page and tx-2026-0028 to Community Impact. CI then found seven items past twice their leash. Six were repaired from fresh reads or measured front door boundaries. tx-2026-0186 stays rotten because www.faa.gov refuses the project's reader and the session's WebFetch, and the safety classifier refused a browser agent read as bot check circumvention. Nothing was admitted. The October 27th branch, which never merged, rides this pull request. The ask engine. The October 27th re-verify correctly added Hudspeth County to tx-2026-0218. Hudspeth is the second county of the El Paso area, so "What is happening in El Paso?" now has a different answer from El Paso County, and the router answers with the county. The patch was tried in a scratch build. It passes the browser test and the engine's self-test, and the eval reads the same with and without it. The deck. Carousel no. 62, Dallas brush truck cameras, selected from tx-2026-0179. Three panel rounds, medians 6.896, 6.992 and 7.086. It ships at the round cap, 0.914 under the 8.0 top rung, with no hard fail found in any round. Permissions. prompt_audit measured 1,898 calls and counted 271 with a permission decision delay. The longest was 24.9 s on an agent spawn, and no Bash call waited more than 4.4 s. The safety classifier refused one call, the browser agent read of faa.gov. no-stall hook: armed at 2026-10-28T05:04:00Z. At session start it judged the session unattended (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and the host's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED was 0. It refused nothing.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
